manifest.name: dsh-plugin-market
manifest.description: Plugin market button for the dsh web UI: one click opens dshmarket.com, the community plugin market for DeepSeek Harness

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-market bundle patch
#
# Installing the package with
#
#   dsh plugin --profile web add github:changan0617/dsh-plugin-market
#
# appends `dsh-plugin-market` to the profile's bundle stack and merges this
# single `insert` row. Remove with
#
#   dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-market
#
# The double-mount guard backs this row out when the same package is already
# mounted by another entry.
- insert:
    - id: plugin-market-button
      name: 'dsh-plugin-market'
      disabled: !!js "[...ctx.loader.entries()].some((e) => e.options.name === 'dsh-plugin-market' && e.options.id !== 'plugin-market-button' && !e.disabled)"

readme.text:
Adds a **Plugin Market** entry to the DSH settings sidebar that opens
[dshmarket.com](https://dshmarket.com/) — the community plugin market for
DeepSeek Harness — in a new tab.

For most people this plugin is unnecessary: installing the market itself

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
```

puts a full browse / search / one-click-install market inside the settings
page. This plugin is the light-weight alternative for people who want a button
and nothing else.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:changan0617/dsh-plugin-market
```

Restart `dsh web`. The entry appears in the settings sidebar next to the
built-in Plugins page.
